definitions.explanation: Performing, creating, or doing something spontaneously without prior preparation or planning. Common in music, theater, and speech.

examples.japanese: ジャズは{即興|そっきょう}{演奏|えんそう}が{魅力|みりょく}だ。
examples.english: The appeal of jazz is its improvisation.

examples.japanese: {即興|そっきょう}でスピーチをすることになった。
examples.english: I ended up having to give an impromptu speech.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{即興|そっきょう}で{詩|し}を{作|つく}るのが{得意|とくい}だ。
examples.english: He's good at composing poems on the spot.

notes:
USAGE:
Can be used as a noun or as a modifier with の.
・{即興|そっきょう}で〜する - to do something impromptu
・{即興|そっきょう}の〜 - impromptu ~

COLLOCATIONS:
・{即興|そっきょう}{演奏|えんそう} - improvised performance
・{即興|そっきょう}{劇|げき} - improvisational theater
・{即興|そっきょう}{曲|きょく} - improvised piece
・{即興|そっきょう}スピーチ - impromptu speech
・{即興|そっきょう}で{作|つく}る - to create on the spot

SIMILAR WORDS:
・アドリブ - ad-lib (from English)
・{思|おも}いつき - sudden idea, whim
